masthead.title: CASUALS CUP - VIOLENCE LEAGUE
masthead.subtitle: Not the best. Just the most exciting.
masthead.tagline: Welcome to the goon league. Yes, that goon league. Hits count. Penalty minutes count. Assists are for guys who hold hands on the bus.
masthead.note: Season opens September 29. Everything here is ESPN projections and last season's NHL numbers until the pucks drop. Pitter patter.

goon.name: Goon
goon.bio: Polite. Calls everyone bud. Will rearrange your face and then apologize, and mean it both times.
goon.hello: Hey there, bud. Welcome to the room. Sorry in advance. And no, not that kind of goon. Well. Some of you.

shoresy.name: Shoresy
shoresy.bio: Has chirped every man in this league and most of their moms. Scores his own chirps out of ten. Hands out penalties nobody asked for.
shoresy.hello: Sit down, take your lid off, and nobody touch my fucking stick tape, you pylons. Or my Twisted Tea. Or my linemate's mom.

projections.title: Where the room has everybody
projections.note: Projected lineup points for the season. Left column is our league's scoring, where a hit is worth a point and a fight is worth more. Right column is the same rosters under plain ESPN scoring, the way your uncle's league does it.
projections.goon: The top four here are the bottom-feeders over there, bud. That's not a bug, that's the league. Sorry to anybody who drafted from a magazine.
projections.shoresy: Tyler drafted McDavid and finished fourteenth in a league that pays for hits. That's like bringing a violin to a bar fight and asking the bouncer for a tuning fork. Nine out of ten, and the one's for the fork.

violence.title: The penalty sheet
violence.note: Every roster's skaters, last NHL season: major penalties (nearly all fighting majors), penalty minutes and hits. Each room's enforcer is the guy with the most majors.
violence.goon: Fifty-seven majors on one roster. I'd like to meet those boys. Carefully. From behind a Zamboni. With a lawyer.
violence.shoresy: Half this league thinks penalty minutes are something that happens to other people. Look at your number. If it starts with a three, your whole team apologizes to the linesman before the linesman apologizes to you.

opener.title: Week two
opener.note: Matchup period 2, Monday October 5 through Sunday October 11. Seven teams are still unbeaten and seven have yet to win one.
opener.goon: Week two, boys. Seven of you are oh and two and I'm not gonna pile on, that's not my job. My job is the guy who piles on. Sorry. Set your lineups, bud.
opener.shoresy: Oh and two club, roll call: you're seven deep and none of you can find the net with a map and a flashlight. Week two. Gooners, unclench, the waiver wire won't touch itself. Okay it will. Ten out of ten, I'm the best at this.

standings.goon: Seven rooms unbeaten, seven winless, six in the middle, bud. Matthew's Something's Bruin leads on points with 261.9, and Pancakes is up there with them after knocking off McDavid's team, which I'm not sorry about at all. Goo Squad is on the bottom with 114.7. Brennan, that's a starting line, not a verdict. I'll be by with a sports drink.
standings.shoresy: Two weeks in and the board already looks like a police lineup. Richard Bobby second on points and nineteenth in any league your uncle runs. Anger issues inc fourth here, eighteenth there, so Tom is the most profitable mistake in the standings. Down the bottom, Goo Squad scored 114.7, which is what a decent roster puts up on a Tuesday, and Brennan did it over a whole week. Seven unbeaten, seven winless, and six of you in the middle pretending that was the plan. Eight out of ten, two minutes to the whole bottom seven for loitering.

napkinWall.goon: Write whatever you want on the wall, bud. Keep it about the guy's team and his fantasy decisions. Plenty of material there.
napkinWall.shoresy: Pin a napkin, name a team, and they get a ping the second you do. That's right, you can ruin a man's dinner from your couch. Best feature on the site. Ten out of ten.

sideBets.goon: Loser buys. Pays before he sits down. If you welch in this room, I'll be very disappointed in you, and I'll tell you so, standing very close.
sideBets.shoresy: Put your money where your mouth is, which for half of you is a Twisted Tea and a Tim's gift card from 2019. The house settles anything the box score can prove. Duck a bet and your name goes on the glass.

poll.goon: One vote each. Change it until it closes. Voting for yourself is allowed. It's also sad, bud.
poll.shoresy: Vote for whoever's getting their teeth knocked in. If you pick your own team, that's the most honest scouting report you've filed all year.

tab.goon: Who posts, who bets, who pays. Keeping track so nobody has to argue about it in the parking lot. Unless you want to. I'm free.
tab.shoresy: The tab. Napkins, replies, bets won and bets ducked. Top of this list is the loudest guy in the room. Bottom is the guy who reads everything and never posts, and bud, we all know who you are.

guestStool.goon: Not in the league? That's okay, bud. Pull up a stool. You're safer out there anyways.
guestStool.shoresy: Leave your email and get the week in your inbox. No passcode, no team, no dignity required, which puts you level with about six managers in here already.

Anger issues inc.shoresy: Passed on every scorer in the draft on purpose and took guys who finish checks. Twenty other managers are out here dangling like cake eaters. Tom's boys run you through the glass, go to the box, and finish their beer. Ten out of ten. I hate it. I'd block a slapper for it.
Anger issues inc.goon: Most hits in the league by eight hundred. Those boys don't fight much. They just finish every single check, every shift, forever. I respect a finisher. Sorry to whoever's in front of them. And behind them.
Anger issues inc.scouting: Beat Percocet Pucks 233.5 to 148.75, the biggest margin of the week, on the back of 3,518 hits worth of roster. First in this league's projection, eighteenth in a normal one. Kaiden Guhle is on injured reserve, and the board only likes this room for 174.6 this week against the top team.

Something's Bruin.shoresy: Took every hitter on the board one pick early like you were reading the draft off the guy next to you, then waited until pick 220 for a goalie. Matthew, you didn't draft a team, you cheated off one, you plagiarizing plug. And your Jamie Benn just lost a fight to a free agent. Two minutes for copying.
Something's Bruin.goon: Zadorov had 152 penalty minutes on his own. Good man. Probably apologizes after, too. I would. I do.
Something's Bruin.scouting: Beat Will's Wild Team 261.9 to 228.35, the most points in the league, and Jack McBain took 89 percent of the vote off Will Cuylle on Sunday night. First on the board, first in a normal league, second in this one. Alexandre Carrier is day to day. Favoured by 122 over Anger issues inc, the biggest spread of the week.

ICE Enforcers.shoresy: Jared renamed the team Enforcers and started the year with two guys suspended. Enforcing what, you pylon? The league office's calendar? Your team name has more fight in it than your whole fucking October. Eight out of ten, two games for the rename.
ICE Enforcers.goon: Tom Wilson on the roster. That's a real one. Nobody takes liberties on that bench. Sorry, everybody else. Mostly sorry to the other bench.
ICE Enforcers.scouting: Beat Ray Lewis Killed a Guy 216.75 to 137.5 with Charlie McAvoy and Ridly Greig suspended and Max Domi out. Luke Schenn went with Klapka on Saturday and Collin Graf went with Balinskis on Thursday, so the name is earning its keep. Third in this league's projection, second in a normal one, and the board gives this room 274.8 this week.

Richard Bobby.shoresy: Richard named his team after himself, took Makar in round one, then spent the night stealing hitters out of other guys' queues like a raccoon in a Boston Pizza dumpster. Fourth here, nineteenth anywhere normal. Pick a lane, Ricky, you big beautiful muffin merchant.
Richard Bobby.goon: Olivier had eleven majors last year. That's my kind of fella. Tell him I said hi. From a distance. A big one.
Richard Bobby.scouting: Beat Fridge Cigarettes 253.45 to 178.15, second on the board on points. Adam Klapka dropped the gloves with Luke Schenn on Saturday, rated 5.93, so Olivier is not the only one in the room who goes. Danila Yurov is day to day. Fourth in this league's projection, nineteenth in a normal one, and that is the whole point.

The Mobile Leprechauns.shoresy: Joe took Boldy tenth overall and Boldy went out and lost a fight vote zero percent to fuck all. First goalie at pick 311, Malkin in round ten. Joe, you didn't draft a team, you went through a garage sale in three decades and bought everything that smelled okay. Bender.
The Mobile Leprechauns.goon: Nobody on this roster fought more than once. Real gentle crew. Nice fellas. Their best player just found out what a fight feels like. Sorry, Joe. Sorry, Matt.
The Mobile Leprechauns.scouting: Beat Chicago Bedards 249.3 to 242.35 in the third-closest game of the week. Boldy, Guentzel and Scheifele up front, no injury tags, the only clean sheet in the league. Six majors on the whole roster last year, so every point comes the polite way.

Team Tenis.shoresy: Michael took Kucherov third overall in a league that pays for hits, then renamed the team and spelled it wrong. It's two words, bud. One of them is team. That's the most violent thing this pigeon will do all year. Nine out of ten.
Team Tenis.goon: Fourth best normal team in the league. In this league, bud, normal gets you a bag of pucks, a pat on the head and a ride home from a nice man. Sorry, Michael.
Team Tenis.scouting: Beat Goontown Gaitors 203.3 to 119.45, the second-biggest margin of the week, with Kucherov and Kempe carrying it. Seth Jarvis is on injured reserve, so the top three is a top two. Seventh in this league's projection, sixth on the board, and favoured by 17 over Pancakes.

Goo Squad.shoresy: Brennan's first goalie came at pick 235, then he drafted two guys who don't have NHL teams. You drafted a free agent camp, you absolute pylon. Goo is the right name. I've seen what's on the dressing room floor and it had more direction than this.
Goo Squad.goon: Five majors from the whole roster all year. Goo's the right word, bud. Sorry. It just is.
Goo Squad.scouting: Scored 114.7 against Young Stroker's Body Snatchers, the lowest total in the league, and lost by 57.6. Robertson, Geekie and Seider are supposed to carry it. Matt Savoie and Yanni Gourde are on injured reserve. Eighth in this league's projection, fifth in a normal one, twentieth on the board, and favoured by 15 over Fridge Cigarettes anyway.

Chicago Bedards.shoresy: Michael G. took MacKinnon first overall, added Rantanen and Barkov, and then named the whole team after a guy on somebody else's roster. That's naming your boat after your ex while she's waterskiing behind another guy's boat. Two minutes for embellishment, you cake eater.
Chicago Bedards.goon: Josh Anderson leads the room with four majors. Good start, bud. You need about three more of him. And a better name.
Chicago Bedards.scouting: Scored 242.35, fourth-most in the league, and lost to The Mobile Leprechauns by 6.95. Connor Bedard is on injured reserve and Aaron Ekblad is day to day, so the team's namesake is off the lineup card for now. MacKinnon and Rantanen carry it. Ninth in this league's projection, and an 85-point underdog to ICE Enforcers this week.

Fridge Cigarettes.shoresy: Greg took Matthews at 17 and a guy with no NHL team at 231. The fridge is on fire, the cigarettes are wet, and the whole roster smells like both. Kaprizov does the scoring, Kolesar does the rest, and Greg does fuck all. Eight out of ten, for the smell.
Fridge Cigarettes.goon: Kolesar does the fighting and the rest of them hold his coat. One guy working, twelve guys watching. I've been that guy. Sorry, Keegan.
Fridge Cigarettes.ribbon: WINLESS ON THE SHEET, OH AND TWO IN THE FIGHTS
Fridge Cigarettes.scouting: Lost to Richard Bobby 178.15 to 253.45, then Kolesar and Cuylle both lost fights on Sunday, 96 and 89 percent of the vote going the other way. Kaprizov still does the scoring. DeBrusk is day to day and Severson is on injured reserve. Tenth in this league's projection and winless anyway.

Swahili James.shoresy: Swahili James is Matt's alter ego, and bud, that man never breaks character. Not on draft night, not in the group chat, not when his defenseman is out there beating up first round picks. Seven D-men, Letang in round fourteen, and somehow first in the league in violence bonus. Method acting. Nine out of ten, and the Oscar goes to Matt.
Swahili James.goon: Harley went straight up, finished it, took his ten and sat down. And James stayed in character the whole time. Commitment like that, bud, you can't coach it. Sorry to Boldy.
Swahili James.ribbon: WON BY 4.15 WITH TWO ON THE SHELF
Swahili James.scouting: Beat mentally bedarded 191.45 to 187.3, the closest game of the week. Reinhart, Tavares and Cooley did the scoring while Bryan Rust and Kevin Fiala sat on injured reserve. Eleventh in this league's projection, eighth in a normal one, and the board gives this room a 267.1 this week, fourth-highest on the card.

Ray Lewis Killed a Guy.shoresy: Joe M. picked the toughest team name in the league and then finished sixth in majors. The name's writing cheques this roster's too soft to cash, you tough-talking bender. Two minutes for impersonating a tough guy, ten for the misconduct of choosing it.
Ray Lewis Killed a Guy.goon: Corey Perry leads the room in majors. Still starting things after all these years, bud. Tell the young guys to follow the old man. He knows where the bodies are. The metaphorical ones.
Ray Lewis Killed a Guy.scouting: Lost to ICE Enforcers 137.5 to 216.75. Brady Tkachuk fought Jacob Trouba seven minutes into opening night and took 46 percent of the vote, the roster's best moment. Jake Sanderson is out, Brock Faber and Alex Lyon are on injured reserve. Twelfth in this league's projection, eighteenth on the board right now.

All Pro Toews Suckers.shoresy: Nic took four goalies and three guys who were already on injured reserve before a puck dropped. Half the roster's in the hot tub with a Twisted Tea and the other half is a goalie. The name's a dare nobody took, you walking pylon. Seven out of ten.
All Pro Toews Suckers.goon: Nobody on this roster fought more than twice. Dahlin leads the room with two majors, bud. Toews would've fought for you. Sorry, Toews. Sorry, Nic.
All Pro Toews Suckers.ribbon: WINLESS WITH TWO ON THE SHELF
All Pro Toews Suckers.scouting: Lost to carter hart hate club 169.3 to 196.95. Forsberg, Necas and Dahlin are the engine, and Mathew Barzal and Artem Zub are on injured reserve. Thirteenth in both projections, sixteenth on the board, and a 26-point underdog to Will this week.

Tyler's Talented Team.shoresy: Tyler has McDavid and the fewest hits in the league. Fourteenth. You brought a science fair project to a parking lot fight, you soft-handed cake eater, and the volcano's not even baking soda, it's a picture of a volcano. Pitter patter, Tyler. Pitter patter.
Tyler's Talented Team.goon: 781 hits for the whole roster, dead last. I hit seven hundred things on the way to the rink. Two of them were people. Sorry about them. Sorry about this, Tyler.
Tyler's Talented Team.scouting: McDavid, Nylander and Keller, and still lost to Pancakes 197.05 to 202.8. 781 hits for the whole roster last season, the fewest in the league, and it showed. Rasmus Sandin is on injured reserve. Fourteenth in this league's projection, and favoured by 96 this week, so no excuses.

Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.shoresy: Sean's first goalie is suspended. You drafted a man who isn't allowed to play, with a roster spot, in a draft, on purpose, you absolute sieve of a general manager. Two minutes for poor attendance, and the goalie gets a ten for the same thing.
Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.goon: Sam Carrick had nine majors by himself. One man carrying a whole room on his back. God bless him. Somebody buy that man a beer. Sean, it's you. You buy it.
Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.ribbon: WON BY 57.6, TWO GOALIES ON THE SHELF
Young Stroker’s Body Snatchers.scouting: Beat Goo Squad 172.3 to 114.7 with Connor Hellebuyck and Elvis Merzlikins both on injured reserve, along with Ryan Nugent-Hopkins. Jacob Trouba fought Brady Tkachuk on opening night and the voters called it close. Sam Carrick is still the room's heavyweight with nine majors last year. Fifteenth in this league's projection, thirteenth on the board.

Goontown Gaitors.shoresy: Robert K. named his team Goontown and his one goon has no NHL team. Both goalies are on injured reserve. That's not Goontown, you fucking pigeon, that's a ghost town with a mascot. Ten out of ten, put it on the sign, then take the sign down.
Goontown Gaitors.goon: Reaves has five of the seven majors on that roster, bud. That's not a Goontown, that's a Reavestown. And Reaves is looking for work. Sorry, Ryan. Sorry, Robert.
Goontown Gaitors.ribbon: FIVE TAGS, THREE OF THEM GOALIES
Goontown Gaitors.scouting: Lost to Team Tenis 119.45 to 203.3, the second-lowest total in the league. Zach Hyman is out, and Dylan Larkin, Filip Gustavsson, Joonas Korpisalo and Thatcher Demko are all on injured reserve, three of them goalies. Svechnikov and Holloway are what's left up front. Sixteenth in this league's projection, nineteenth on the board, and still favoured by 9 over the other Robert.

Will's Wild Team.shoresy: Will took Draisaitl at 12 and Kyle Quincey in round twenty. Somebody hit auto, went for a rip, forgot where he parked, and came back to three majors for the whole roster, fewest in the league. Wild is a strong word for a bender like this. Two minutes for delay of game.
Will's Wild Team.goon: Wildest guy on the team is Weegar. Nice player. Not wild, bud. Mildly spicy. Sorry, Weegar. Sorry, Will.
Will's Wild Team.scouting: Scored 228.35, sixth-most in the league for the week, and lost, because the other guy was Something's Bruin at 261.9. Draisaitl, Weegar and Connor did their part. Troy Terry is on injured reserve and Oliver Kapanen is day to day. Seventeenth in this league's projection and favoured by 26 over Nic this week.

Pancakes.shoresy: Benjamin went two defensemen deep on draft night with five D slots to fill, then fixed it off the wire before anybody noticed. Celebrini at four, Raddysh at 117, the steal of the night. I hate saying nice things. Six out of ten, and from me that's a parade.
Pancakes.goon: Celebrini's gonna be a problem for a long time, bud. Good pick. Good man. No sorry needed on this one. Proud of you, Benjamin.
Pancakes.scouting: Beat Tyler's Talented Team 202.8 to 197.05, Celebrini over McDavid, the first upset on the board. Seventh in the standings and unbeaten while the projection has this room nineteenth, which is the projection's problem. Justin Brazeau is on injured reserve. Goon likes this team and still isn't sorry about it.

carter hart hate club.shoresy: Most majors in the league and dead last in both projections. All fists, zero points. Jordan didn't draft a fantasy team, he drafted a parking lot at 1 a.m. after a Senators game. Ten out of ten. No notes. Somebody call their moms, and tell them to bring bail money.
carter hart hate club.goon: That's a room I'd want at my back in a parking lot. Not on a power play. Not anywhere with a scoreboard. Sorry, boys. Sorry, Jordan.
carter hart hate club.ribbon: WON THE GAME, LOST THE FIGHT
carter hart hate club.scouting: Beat All Pro Toews Suckers 196.95 to 169.3, so the roster with 57 majors last season can score after all. Then Kastelic dropped the gloves with Tyrel Bauer on Friday and 79 percent of the voters went the other way. No injury tags. Dead last in both projections and winning anyway.

Percocet Pucks.shoresy: Robert G. went from Remarkable Team to Percocet Pucks in one week, which is the most honest rebrand in sports. Took Ryan Suter in round twenty in a hitting league, and now he needs something for the pain. Me too, bud. Watching your roster. Eight out of ten, and a refill.
Percocet Pucks.goon: New name, same four majors and 416 penalty minutes, second fewest in the league. Remarkably polite, still. You can rename the team, bud. The roster knows who it is. Sorry, Robert.
Percocet Pucks.ribbon: LOST BY 84.75, NEW NAME STILL HURTS
Percocet Pucks.scouting: Lost to Anger issues inc 148.75 to 233.5, the biggest margin of the week, which is what happens when 416 penalty minutes meets 3,518 hits. Zibanejad, Hischier and Eichel up front. Matt Duchene and Jonathan Huberdeau are on injured reserve. Eighteenth in this league's projection, seventeenth on the board, and the Roberts play each other this week.

mentally bedarded.shoresy: Brenden finally dropped the Toms dream team bit and made his logo Connor Bedard falling on his ass. Problem, bud: Bedard plays for Michael G. Your mascot is another guy's player hitting the ice, which is still the most accurate scouting report on this page. Ovechkin, Kane, Stamkos and Doughty, a lineup that peaked in 2014, and 43.05 points so far this week. Six out of ten, you nostalgic sieve.
mentally bedarded.goon: Fifth both ways. Consistent. Five majors on the whole roster though, bud. We gotta get some hair on this team's chest. Sorry, Brenden.
mentally bedarded.scouting: Lost to Swahili James 187.3 to 191.45, the closest game of the week. Jake Neighbours won his fight Friday with 83 percent of the vote, the first win in the fists column for this room. Frederik Andersen is on injured reserve and Simon Edvinsson is out. Fifth in this league's projection and winless, so the roster is better than the record.

matchupLines.15-19: Will brought Draisaitl and three majors for the whole roster to a matchup with Zadorov's 152 penalty minutes. Will, you're not a lineup, you're a fucking hostage situation with better skating. Four out of ten, and Matthew gets the other six.
matchupLines.17-1: Tom's team threw 825 more hits than anybody in this league last year. Robert G. brought Zibanejad and four majors. Robert, wear a cup, write your mom a letter, and tape your cell number inside your helmet so they know who to call.
matchupLines.7-11: Fifty-seven majors against Nic's roster with three guys on injured reserve before a puck drops. Jordan's boys will hit everything that moves and still lose on points, and they'll go home happy. Seven out of ten for the violence, zero for the math.
matchupLines.9-22: Goontown's only real fighter has no NHL team. Michael S. has Kucherov and a team name he can't spell. Robert K., your goon is on the couch and both your goalies are on the shelf. Two pigeons in a parking lot. Five out of ten.
matchupLines.13-5: Celebrini against McDavid, and Benjamin's the one who actually showed up to play. Tyler has the most talent in the room and the fewest hits, which is the fantasy version of a guy who brings a boat to a moving day. Eight out of ten, Pancakes.
matchupLines.12-10: Matt D. owns the man who just won the fight of the week. Across the ice, Brenden renamed his team after a player he doesn't even own, and his logo is that guy going down like a lawn chair. Ovechkin and Kane against a guy with a better sense of timing. Seven out of ten, Swahili.
matchupLines.18-23: Sam Carrick had nine majors by himself. Brennan's whole roster had five. Sean's starting goalie is suspended, so Carrick might have to play net, and honestly he'd fight the puck and win. Seven out of ten.
matchupLines.20-6: Joe D.'s first round pick lost a fight vote zero to nothing. Zero. Not one person on the internet thought he won. Michael G. has MacKinnon, Rantanen and Barkov and named the team after a guy on somebody else's roster. Both of you, two minutes for embarrassing the sport. Six out of ten.
matchupLines.14-4: Richard named his team after himself and then drafted like he was scared of himself. Olivier had eleven majors on his own. Greg has Kaprizov for goals and Kolesar for everything else. Ricky, drop the fucking gloves in the first shift and let the math sort itself out. Eight out of ten.
matchupLines.8-21: Jared's team is called ICE Enforcers and it starts the season with two guys suspended. That's not a team name, that's a confession. Joe M. has Corey Perry, who is still starting things older than half this league. Nine out of ten for the whole situation.
matchupLines.19-1: Matthew's Something's Bruin put up 261.9, the most points in the league, and McBain took 89 percent of a fight vote Sunday for dessert. Tom's Anger issues inc threw 3,518 hits last season and the board still has this one Matthew by 122, because Tom's roster drew the week where half of it is watching from the couch. Tom, you built a wrecking crew and scheduled it for a Tuesday. Eight out of ten, two minutes to Tom for a light week in a heavy lineup.
matchupLines.11-15: Nic's All Pro Toews Suckers scored 169.3, lost, and have Barzal and Zub on injured reserve, so the holes on that roster have holes. Will's Wild Team lost to the top team by 33.55 and has three majors on the whole roster, which is one fight a month if they ration them. One of these rooms has Draisaitl and still only projects for 253.9. Will by 26 on the board. Six out of ten, two minutes to Nic for naming the team after a guy he then had to draft himself.
matchupLines.22-17: The battle of the Roberts, and both of them are winless. Robert K.'s Goontown Gaitors scored 119.45 with Hyman out and Larkin, Gustavsson, Korpisalo and Demko all on injured reserve, which is three goalies on the shelf and a top liner on the couch. Robert G.'s Percocet Pucks scored 148.75 against the league's hitting machine and have Duchene and Huberdeau on injured reserve. Somebody has to win this. The board says Robert K. by 9. Five out of ten, and both Roberts get two minutes for making me type Robert twice.
matchupLines.5-7: Tyler's Talented Team lost to Pancakes by 5.75 with McDavid in the lineup, which is losing a bar fight while holding the chair. Jordan's carter hart hate club won by 27.65 and then Kastelic had 79 percent of the vote taken off him by Bauer on Friday. Fifty-seven majors on that roster and the first tilt of the year was an L. The board has Tyler by 96, and if Tyler loses this one with that roster he should hand the login to McDavid. Seven out of ten, two minutes to Jordan for a lineup that fights the way it scores.
matchupLines.13-9: Benjamin's Pancakes beat McDavid's team by 5.75 with Celebrini doing the heavy lifting, the first real upset on this board. Michael S.'s Team Tenis put up 203.3 against the second-worst score in the league and has Jarvis on injured reserve, so the top line is already a duo. The board says Tenis by 17, which is the same board that had Pancakes nineteenth before they started winning. Seven out of ten, two minutes to Michael S. for the spelling, still, two weeks in.
matchupLines.10-23: Brenden's mentally bedarded lost by 4.15, has Andersen on injured reserve and Edvinsson out, and is named after Connor Bedard, who plays for Michael G.'s roster and is now on injured reserve himself. So the team is named after a man who is not playing, for a man who does not own him. Neighbours did take 83 percent of a fight vote Friday, so there is one pulse in the room. Sean's Young Stroker's Body Snatchers won by 57.6 with Hellebuyck and Merzlikins both on injured reserve, so Sean is winning with a crease held together by hockey tape. Brenden by 7 on the board. Seven out of ten, two minutes to Brenden for the rename.
matchupLines.6-12: Joe D.'s Mobile Leprechauns won by 6.95 over Michael G., and Boldy did not fight anybody this week, which is growth. Matt's Swahili James squeaked past Brenden by 4.15 with Rust and Fiala on injured reserve, so a win is a win, but a 4.15 win with two guys on the shelf is a win with the check engine light on. Highest combined total on the board this week, 526 between them, Matt by 8. Six out of ten, two minutes to Joe D. for six majors on a roster in a league that pays by the punch.
matchupLines.4-18: Two winless teams, and one of them had the worst week in the league. Brennan's Goo Squad scored 114.7, dead last for the week, with Savoie and Gourde on injured reserve, and the board still likes them eighth for the season, so somebody explain that to Brennan slowly. Greg's Fridge Cigarettes lost by 75.3 and then his two heavies, Kolesar and Cuylle, lost their fights Sunday with 96 and 89 percent of the vote going the other way. Greg, your roster lost on the scoresheet and in the parking lot. Goo Squad by 15 on the board. Eight out of ten, two minutes to Greg for the worst fight record in the league, oh and two.
matchupLines.21-20: Jared's ICE Enforcers won by 79.25 with McAvoy and Greig suspended and Domi out, so the healthy half of the roster is doing the work and the other half is doing paperwork. Luke Schenn and Collin Graf both dropped the mitts this week, which is more than most of this league managed. Michael G.'s Chicago Bedards lost by 6.95 and now Bedard is on injured reserve and Ekblad is day to day, so the team is named after a hole in its own lineup. Second-biggest spread on the board, Jared by 85. Eight out of ten, two minutes to Michael G. for the name and ten for the misconduct of 242.35 still being a loss.
matchupLines.8-14: Joe M.'s Ray Lewis Killed a Guy scored 137.5 and lost by 79.25, with Sanderson out and Faber and Lyon on injured reserve.
